implementation.dependencies: Python standard library only; hashlib SHA-256 and RIPEMD-160
implementation.curve: secp256k1 affine modular arithmetic; byte-wise double/add, independent of tiny-secp256k1
implementation.base58: own mainnet Base58Check encoder; double-SHA256 checksum
implementation.segwit: own BIP173 Bech32 for v0 and BIP350 Bech32m for v1
implementation.taproot: even-Y lift of x-only internal public key; BIP341 tagged TapTweak; no script-tree root; reject out-of-range tweak and infinity
implementation.secretHandling: Transient digest in memory only; never serialize or print private scalar/minikey; mutable digest buffer cleared best-effort

coverage: scalar-one generator and known P2PKH addresses
Taproot odd/even-Y normalization equivalence from the scalar-one public point
CLI self-test output and argument/schema/private-path guards
limitations: No positive 22-character minikey control was derived because only the registered 30-character example and scalar-one controls were authorized
Not a complete cryptographic implementation audit or exhaustive generic address decoder test
Python affine arithmetic is variable-time; Python/OpenSSL do not guarantee complete memory zeroization
Private target input/output CLI branch deliberately not exercised before root preregistration
Rare TapTweak out-of-range/infinity rejection branches are implemented but no forced fault-injection tests were run
